reviewer: AI (Claude) independent reviewers (blind solve + informed review), separate from the author; not a native-speaker or teacher review

set.q: A bird is sitting on the roof. A cat is under the tree. Where is the bird?
set.why: 새는 지붕 위(on the roof)에 앉아 있어요.

patches.why: Remove 'Look at the picture' (no picture exists); identity field q changes.
Parallel options remove the frame/length cue (identity field o changes).

set.good: The bank is between the school and the park.
bad: The bank is between the school the park.
The bank is between the school with the park.
The bank is between the school or the park.

cz.st: The bank is ___ the school and the park.

set.rule: between은 'A and B' 형태로 두 대상 사이를 말해요.

patches.why: Word order not unique (school/park swap); disable ordering.

set.good: She walks along the river with her dog.
set.ko: 그녀는 강을 따라 개와 함께 걸어요.
bad: She walks along to the river with her dog.
She walks the river along with her dog.
She walk along the river with her dog.

cz.st: She walks ___ the river with her dog.

set.rule: along은 '~을 따라'라는 뜻이고 to 없이 바로 장소가 와요. 주어가 She이면 동사에 s를 붙여요.

patches.why: 'with her dog' can move; disable ordering.

set.ex: Dad is on the first floor. He is downstairs in the kitchen.
set.exko: 아빠는 1층에 있어요. 아빠는 아래층 부엌에 있어요.

set.ex: Many trees grow along the road.

set.good: The dog runs toward the gate.
bad: The dog runs toward to the gate.
The dog runs the gate toward.
The dog run toward the gate.
set.rule: toward는 '~을 향해'라는 뜻이고 to 없이 바로 장소가 와요. 주어가 The dog이면 동사에 s를 붙여요.

patches.why: Off-skill (wh-question) replaced by a preposition sentence; identity field good changes.

criteria: single defensible answer (blind solve), natural English, level, distractor validity, hint and explanation
